name: SOULBOND
source:
When Marisol stumbles in the forest, she accidentally finds herself caught in the web of hatred, rage and a thirst for vengeance. 

The war between witch and monster is a long one, and it's finally time to finish it, once and for all. With both the witch and the monster striving to put a final end to each other, Marisol somehow finds herself caught in the conflict of war, and that of her own emotions. 

Who will Marisol side with? Who will succeed in their plot for revenge? What costs await them in the end? The choice rests in your hands...

[From [url=https://celadonstudios.itch.io/soulbond]itch.io[/url]]
